metadata.title: Jaipur Stonecraft — Approved Product Taxonomy Consolidation Mapping

targetSubcategories.name: Mandirs & Temples
targetSubcategories.description: Handcrafted marble home mandirs, temple architecture, and sacred pooja room stonework.
targetSubcategories.reason: Core mandir and temple category approved in Section 3.A.1

targetSubcategories.name: Jali & Stone Screens
targetSubcategories.description: Perforated stone lattice screens for partitions, balconies, facades, and windows.
targetSubcategories.reason: Approved in Section 3.A.2. Slug preserved for SEO stability.

targetSubcategories.name: Pillars, Arches & Architectural Elements
targetSubcategories.description: Hand-carved marble pillars, structural stone columns, torans, and architectural arches.
targetSubcategories.reason: Approved in Section 3.A.3. Slug preserved for SEO stability.

targetSubcategories.name: Jharokhas & Heritage Stonework
targetSubcategories.description: Traditional stone jharokhas, heritage balconies, chhatri gazebos, and structural components.
targetSubcategories.reason: Approved in Section 3.A.4. Slug preserved for SEO stability.

targetSubcategories.name: Religious & Spiritual Wall Art
targetSubcategories.description: Sacred stone wall murals, deity reliefs, and devotional stone narrative relief panels.
targetSubcategories.reason: Consolidates overlapping religious-reliefs and wall-murals into Section 3.B.1

targetSubcategories.name: Heritage & Decorative Wall Art
targetSubcategories.description: Intricately carved stone relief panels, Rajasthani heritage scenes, floral motifs, and geometric wall carvings.
targetSubcategories.reason: Replaces duplicate stone-relief-panels subcategory naming per Section 3.B.2

targetSubcategories.name: Custom Wall Art & Reliefs
targetSubcategories.description: Commissioned architectural feature walls, commemorative reliefs, and bespoke stone murals.
targetSubcategories.reason: Approved in Section 3.B.3. Relocated to Wall Art & Reliefs where relief panels belong.

targetSubcategories.name: Tiered & Classical Fountains
targetSubcategories.description: Classical multi-tier marble and stone water fountains, courtyard centerpieces, and lotus basins.
targetSubcategories.reason: Consolidates tiered fountains, courtyard fountains, and lotus basins per Section 3.C.1

targetSubcategories.name: Wall & Freestanding Fountains
targetSubcategories.description: Architectural wall fountains, freestanding garden water features, and stone spouts.
targetSubcategories.reason: Consolidates wall and freestanding fountains per Section 3.C.2

targetSubcategories.name: Sculptural Water Features
targetSubcategories.description: Cascading stone water walls, poolside waterfalls, and figurative water sculptures.
targetSubcategories.reason: Approved in Section 3.C.3. Houses cascading water walls, stone waterfalls, and sculptural fountains.

targetSubcategories.name: Planters & Tulsi Pots
targetSubcategories.description: Hand-carved marble and sandstone planters, garden urns, and sacred stone Tulsi pots.
targetSubcategories.reason: Merges separate planters and tulsi-pots subcategories into Section 3.D.1

targetSubcategories.name: Pedestals, Plinths & Stands
targetSubcategories.description: Architectural display pedestals, statue plinths, and carved stone bases.
targetSubcategories.reason: Approved in Section 3.D.2. Expanded display name.

targetSubcategories.name: Decorative & Garden Stone Art
targetSubcategories.description: Stone vases, marble urns, decorative bowls, tabletop statuettes, garden lanterns, and stone benches.
targetSubcategories.reason: Approved in Section 3.D.3. Houses the 28 products previously parked in review-pending.

targetSubcategories.name: Custom Architectural Stonework
targetSubcategories.description: Full temple design and construction, luxury estate stonework, and heritage restoration.
targetSubcategories.reason: Approved in Section 3.E.1. Retained as primary architectural bespoke category.

targetSubcategories.name: Custom Sculptures, Portraits & Reliefs
targetSubcategories.description: Commissioned monumental sculptures, ancestral portraits, and memorial busts.
targetSubcategories.reason: Approved in Section 3.E.2. Houses the 12 products previously parked in review-pending.
